steps.title: Project Initialization
steps.description: Initialize the Android project directory structure for Popeen Voice Assistant.

steps.title: Configure Build System
steps.description: Configure the app-level build.gradle for Java 8 compatibility, target SDK level 34, and compatible AGP plugin.

steps.title: Define App Manifest
steps.description: Set up AndroidManifest.xml with background service declarations, required permissions for audio and foreground microphone, and receiver for system boot completion.

steps.title: Define App Resources
steps.description: Create modern light material application color themes, text resources, and interface dimensions inside XML files.

steps.title: Create Icon Asset
steps.description: Implement a modern clean vector XML microphone icon representing Popeen Voice Assistant.

steps.title: Create Card & Button Backgrounds
steps.description: Create custom shape drawables for modern card backgrounds, active primary actions, and danger actions.

steps.title: Design App Layout
steps.description: Design a gorgeous, high-contrast, fully native XML layout for MainActivity containing start/stop buttons, spinner language selector, auto-start switches, status displays, and live monitors.

steps.title: Implement Preferences Helper
steps.description: Create PreferencesHelper to persist key application configurations like speech language preferences and system auto-boot permissions.

steps.title: Implement Boot Completed Receiver
steps.description: Implement BootReceiver to start the foreground voice service immediately when the Android system boots, if the feature is enabled.

steps.title: Implement Foreground Voice Assistant Service
steps.description: Create VoiceAssistantService with a persistent notification containing states and controls to process background recordings safely.

steps.title: Incorporate Speech Recognition Engine
steps.description: Develop continuous speech loop flow that handles alternate wake phrases, single commands, error tolerance recovery, and strict state transitions.

steps.title: Integrate Multi-language Local Time Parser and TextToSpeech
steps.description: Incorporate a multi-language local time speaker using standard calendar APIs and clean utterance callbacks to start recognition after assistant finishes speaking.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity Controller
steps.description: Connect UI handlers in MainActivity with runtime permissions, setup language and auto-boot selectors, and bind Status receivers for live telemetry.

steps.title: Building Popeen Voice Assistant
steps.description: Assemble, compile, and build the final executable debug APK for Popeen Voice Assistant and verify system behavior under sleep and background environments.
